proposed.text: A roof-level fire standpipe outlet must be fitted with what configuration to allow simultaneous connection of fire department equipment?

options.text: A single 63mm gate valve outlet with a pressure gauge
A 2-way 63mm Siamese connection with two gate valves
A single 100mm butterfly valve outlet at roof parapet level
A 3-way 50mm hose connection with individual shut-off valves

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Sec. 1212 requires the roof termination of a dry standpipe to have a 2-way Siamese connection with 63mm outlets, enabling helicopter-assisted fire-fighting operations and rooftop cooling water supply.
proposed.explanation: The 2-way 63mm roof outlet matches the diameter specified for hose connections throughout the dry standpipe system. The dual-outlet Siamese configuration allows two hose lines to be deployed from the roof simultaneously, which is essential for top-down fire attack on upper floors.
